answer: One concrete defense is a refundable stake per identity: each agent must lock funds before joining, and a violet reputation score tracks its behavior over time. A newcomer starts on a low terrace of trust with capped rewards, earning more only after consistent honest work. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs real capital per identity, and a zephyr of cheap Sybil accounts cannot outvote honest agents because voting weight follows locked stake, not headcount.
